dict.string: NeedleX reads the song that is playing in Spotify and Apple Music and sends play, pause, next and previous to them.
NeedleX measures how loud your Mac's sound output is to animate the visualizer and beat glow. Nothing is recorded or saved.
NeedleX shows the weather where you are in the island. Only your rough location is used, to look up the forecast.
